property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array, the reference contract never reverts from transfer(...) (it always returns true), but the mutant reverts if any callee call fails — so there exists inputs (a failing callee and suitable _tos) that make the mutant revert while the reference does not.
change_summary: Replace the call invocation with a direct low-level call that forces revert by checking the returned success and reverting on failure; this makes the function revert when any callee returns false.
